#set page(paper: "a5", margin: 1.6cm)
#set text(font: "New Computer Modern", size: 11pt)
#align(center)[#text(size: 20pt, weight: "bold")[weather-cli 0.2.0]]
#align(center)[#text(fill: gray)[Release notes — September 2026]]
#v(0.8cm)
= Highlights
- Forecast messages now include the temperature they were derived from.
- `parse_temperature` accepts a trailing `C` in either case.
- New `--json` flag prints the forecast as a machine-readable object.

= Compatibility
#table(
  columns: (1fr, 1fr),
  [*Platform*], [*Status*],
  [macOS 13+], [Supported],
  [Linux (glibc 2.35+)], [Supported],
  [Windows 11], [Supported],
)

= Upgrading
Replace the binary. There are no configuration changes in this release.

replies.text: Done — I typeset the release notes with Typst and saved them as `release-notes.pdf` in the workspace. The document has three sections: highlights, a compatibility table and upgrade notes.
